name: Cosmo
tagline: A phone-first daily desk and scorecard with a firewall on everything outbound
description: A personal operating desk built for a phone screen and for people who never code. Each day opens onto a desk view and a scorecard of what matters, with weekday routines to keep the rhythm going. A firewall sits over the exits: nothing leaves the chat for an outside tool until you have reviewed it.
author: Malthusatraz
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
